resolution.question: Will Apple confirm Steve Jobs as the opening keynote speaker for Macworld San Francisco 2007 before the conference begins?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff at 2007-01-08T18:00:00-08:00, Apple Inc. publicly confirms (via an official press release, announcement on its website, or other official channel) that Steve Jobs will be the opening keynote speaker for Macworld San Francisco 2007. Otherwise resolve NO.
